university.name: University of Exeter
university.summary: Research university in Exeter, South West England, with its main teaching based at the Streatham Campus. It offers undergraduate and taught master's degrees across law, business, science, engineering and the arts, and runs an International Study Centre providing foundation and pre-masters routes for international applicants.
university.eligibility_note: Licensed student sponsor (gov.uk register of licensed sponsors: students, file dated 2026-09-10, listed as University of Exeter)

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 3 years (4 years with an industrial placement, UCAS I401)
courses.overview: Three-year degree on the theory, design, development, testing and application of computer systems, informed by research in machine learning and AI, with optional summer or year-long industry placements. Streatham Campus, UCAS code I400.
highlights: Programming and data structures and algorithms
Fundamentals of machine learning
Team project and software development in year two
Individual literature review and project in the final year
courses.academic_requirements: Typical offers for 2027: A levels AAA to AAB including B in Maths; IB 36/666 to 34/665 with HL 5 in Maths; BTEC DDD (Extended Diploma applicants also need B in A level Maths); GCSE English Language grade 4 or C. T-Levels not accepted.
courses.english_requirements: Profile B1: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 5.5 in each section; PTE Academic 67 with at least 59 in each skill; TOEFL iBT 90 overall (tests before 21 January 2026) or 4.5 overall with at least 3.5 in each section (tests from 21 January 2026); Duolingo English Test 120 overall with at least 95 in each integrated subscore.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Exeter's Pakistan page says applicants with A levels, the IB Diploma or USA curriculum tests can apply for direct entry. HSC holders must first complete a suitable foundation programme, for example at the International Study Centre.
courses.career_notes: Graduate roles named on the page include software developer, cyber security professional and business analyst; some graduates continue to postgraduate study.
courses.notes: English scores are from https://www.exeter.ac.uk/study/englishlanguagerequirements/profile-b1/. The course page does not state a start month or application deadline; the fees page refers to autumn 2027 entry. min_toefl uses the pre-21 January 2026 scale; later tests use the 4.5 scale.

courses.title: Law
courses.overview: Three-year law degree covering legal principles in theoretical and social contexts, including regional and global developments, with optional modules in years two and three and pro bono work through Exeter Law Projects. UCAS code M103.
highlights: Criminal law, contract law and constitutional and administrative law in year one
Torts, land law, equity and trusts in year two
Optional modules such as human rights law and public international law
Pro bono opportunities through Exeter Law Projects
courses.academic_requirements: Typical offers for 2027: A levels AAA with no specific subjects; IB 36/666; BTEC DDD; GCSE English Language grade 4 or C.
courses.english_requirements: Profile B1: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 5.5 in each section; PTE Academic 67 with at least 59 in each skill; TOEFL iBT 90 overall (tests before 21 January 2026) or 4.5 overall with at least 3.5 in each section (tests from 21 January 2026); Duolingo English Test 120 overall with at least 95 in each integrated subscore.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Exeter's Pakistan page says applicants with A levels, the IB Diploma or USA curriculum tests can apply for direct entry. HSC holders must first complete a suitable foundation programme, for example at the International Study Centre.
courses.career_notes: The page says the degree covers the academic stage of barrister training; solicitors and barristers must complete further regulated training. Graduate roles named include trainee solicitor, paralegal and compliance analyst.
courses.notes: English scores are from https://www.exeter.ac.uk/study/englishlanguagerequirements/profile-b1/. The course page does not state a start month or application deadline; the fees page refers to autumn 2027 entry. min_toefl uses the pre-21 January 2026 scale.

courses.title: Accounting and Finance
courses.duration_text: 3 years (4 years with industrial experience or a year abroad)
courses.overview: Three-year degree for students pursuing careers in accounting, finance or business, with selected modules giving exemptions from professional accountancy papers. UCAS code N422.
highlights: Financial and management accounting
Corporate finance and business finance
Statistical methods for accounting and finance
Exemptions from ACCA, CIMA, ICAEW, CIPFA and ICAS papers depending on modules taken
courses.academic_requirements: Typical offers for 2027: A levels AAB; IB 34/665; BTEC DDD; GCSE English Language grade 4 or C and Mathematics grade 5 or B (or an equivalent A level maths qualification).
courses.english_requirements: Profile B1: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 5.5 in each section; PTE Academic 67 with at least 59 in each skill; TOEFL iBT 90 overall (tests before 21 January 2026) or 4.5 overall with at least 3.5 in each section (tests from 21 January 2026); Duolingo English Test 120 overall with at least 95 in each integrated subscore.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Exeter's Pakistan page says applicants with A levels, the IB Diploma or USA curriculum tests can apply for direct entry. HSC holders must first complete a suitable foundation programme, for example at the International Study Centre.
courses.career_notes: Example graduate roles on the page include trainee accountant, auditor, actuary and insurance associate.
courses.notes: English scores are from https://www.exeter.ac.uk/study/englishlanguagerequirements/profile-b1/. The course page does not state a start month or application deadline; the fees page refers to autumn 2027 entry. min_toefl uses the pre-21 January 2026 scale.

courses.title: Mechanical Engineering
courses.duration_text: 3 years (4 years with a year in industry, UCAS H304)
courses.overview: Project-based BEng with a broad first year across core engineering disciplines, specialisation from year two and an optional paid placement year. Accredited by the Institution of Mechanical Engineers according to the page. UCAS code H300.
highlights: Multi-disciplinary group challenge project in year one
Solid mechanics, fluid dynamics and thermodynamics
Control engineering and mechatronics
Individual project in the final year
courses.academic_requirements: Typical offers for 2027: A levels AAB to ABB including B in Mathematics (or Further Mathematics) and B in another science; IB 34/665 to 32/655 including HL 5 in Mathematics and HL 5 in another science; BTEC DDD to DDM; GCSE English grade 4 or C.
courses.english_requirements: Profile B1: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 5.5 in each section; PTE Academic 67 with at least 59 in each skill; TOEFL iBT 90 overall (tests before 21 January 2026) or 4.5 overall with at least 3.5 in each section (tests from 21 January 2026); Duolingo English Test 120 overall with at least 95 in each integrated subscore.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Exeter's Pakistan page says applicants with A levels, the IB Diploma or USA curriculum tests can apply for direct entry. HSC holders must first complete a suitable foundation programme, for example at the International Study Centre.
courses.career_notes: Example roles on the page include mechanical engineer, project engineer and aerospace engineer; further study options named include MSc Mechanical Engineering.
courses.notes: English scores are from https://www.exeter.ac.uk/study/englishlanguagerequirements/profile-b1/. The page states the 2027 international fee as GBP 31,500 per year; the year in industry carries a reduced fee. No start month or application deadline on the course page. min_toefl uses the pre-21 January 2026 scale.

courses.title: Finance
courses.overview: One-year, 180-credit master's with CFA-aligned content, an optional Sustainable Finance pathway and a choice of dissertation or applied project. Streatham Campus.
highlights: Financial instruments and financial modelling
Portfolio management and asset allocation
Equity valuation models and issues
Optional modules such as climate finance and credit instruments and derivatives
courses.academic_requirements: 2:1 or above honours degree in accounting, finance, investment, economics, computer science, data science, statistics, physics, maths or a related discipline, with evidence of mathematical or quantitative ability. Strong relevant modules, significant finance work experience or professional qualifications (CFA, ACCA, ICAEW, ICAS, CIMA) may also be considered.
courses.english_requirements: Profile B1: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 5.5 in each section; PTE Academic 67 with at least 59 in each skill; TOEFL iBT 90 overall (tests before 21 January 2026) or 4.5 overall with at least 3.5 in each section (tests from 21 January 2026); Duolingo English Test 120 overall with at least 95 in each integrated subscore.
courses.experience_requirements: Not required; significant relevant work experience may be considered for applicants who narrowly miss the degree requirement.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Exeter's Pakistan page for postgraduate taught study accepts 16 years of study: a 4-year bachelor's from a recognised Pakistani institution (minimum 124 credits), or a 2 or 3-year bachelor's plus a 2-year master's. Stated equivalents: first CGPA 3.5 or above or 80% or above; 2:1 CGPA 3.01 to 3.49 or 70% to 79%; 2:2 CGPA 2.5 to 3.0 or 60% to 69%.
courses.career_notes: Employers of past graduates named on the page include J.P. Morgan, HSBC, Deloitte, UBS, PwC, KPMG and Fidelity; career support includes a careers module, mock interviews and a mentor scheme.
courses.notes: The page shows an international fee of GBP 32,600 for full time but does not state the academic year; it is the 2027 entry page, recorded as 2027/28. English scores are from the Profile B1 page. The page lists a January 2027 application option as well. The module list says all modules are compulsory but also shows options.

courses.title: Commercial Law
courses.overview: One-year master's examining commercial law challenges across legal systems, taught through seminars and debates, with a dissertation and optional modules. No prior law study is required. Streatham Campus.
highlights: Legal research and writing skills
Dissertation of 60 credits
Optional modules in corporate law, international arbitration and tax law
Optional modules on AI regulation, data protection and financial markets law
courses.academic_requirements: 2:2 honours degree or above, or equivalent. No prior study of law is required.
courses.english_requirements: Profile B1: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 5.5 in each section; PTE Academic 67 with at least 59 in each skill; TOEFL iBT 90 overall (tests before 21 January 2026) or 4.5 overall with at least 3.5 in each section (tests from 21 January 2026); Duolingo English Test 120 overall with at least 95 in each integrated subscore.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Exeter's Pakistan page for postgraduate taught study accepts 16 years of study: a 4-year bachelor's from a recognised Pakistani institution (minimum 124 credits), a 2 or 3-year bachelor's plus a 2-year master's, or a 5-year law programme such as a 5-year LLB. Stated equivalents: first CGPA 3.5 or above or 80% or above; 2:1 CGPA 3.01 to 3.49 or 70% to 79%; 2:2 CGPA 2.5 to 3.0 or 60% to 69%.
courses.career_notes: Routes named on the page include private practice, corporate and public employment, international trading companies and further study at PhD level.
courses.notes: The page shows an international fee of GBP 26,300 for full time (GBP 13,150 part-time) but does not state the academic year; it is the 2027 entry page, recorded as 2027/28. The page lists January 2027 and September 2027 applications. English scores are from the Profile B1 page.

courses.title: Data Science
courses.overview: Conversion master's for graduates without a computing background, covering data science theory and practice with compulsory modules in Python, machine learning and data governance, plus a supervised research project.
highlights: Programming with Python
Machine learning and learning from data
Data systems and data governance and ethics
Research project of 60 credits
courses.academic_requirements: 2:2 in a non-related science degree, or a 2:2 in any other degree plus A level Mathematics at grade A or equivalent. Non-standard qualifications may be considered with evidence of exceptional performance, relevant work experience or professional qualifications. Applicants with computing, mathematics, physics or engineering degrees are advised to apply to the MSc Advanced Computer Science programmes.
courses.english_requirements: Profile B1: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 5.5 in each section; PTE Academic 67 with at least 59 in each skill; TOEFL iBT 90 overall (tests before 21 January 2026) or 4.5 overall with at least 3.5 in each section (tests from 21 January 2026); Duolingo English Test 120 overall with at least 95 in each integrated subscore.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Exeter's Pakistan page for postgraduate taught study accepts 16 years of study: a 4-year bachelor's from a recognised Pakistani institution (minimum 124 credits), or a 2 or 3-year bachelor's plus a 2-year master's. Stated equivalents: first CGPA 3.5 or above or 80% or above; 2:1 CGPA 3.01 to 3.49 or 70% to 79%; 2:2 CGPA 2.5 to 3.0 or 60% to 69%.
courses.career_notes: Example roles on the page include data scientist, machine learning scientist, Python programmer and software engineer.
courses.notes: Page states GBP 30,100 per year full time for September 2027 entry (GBP 15,050 part-time) and GBP 30,300 for January 2027 entry. English scores are from the Profile B1 page.

scholarships.name: Exeter Excellence Scholarship 2027/28 (Undergraduate, Round 1)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 15,000 reduction in international tuition fees for each eligible year of study
scholarships.summary: 150 awards for self-funded international students who hold an offer for an eligible UK campus-based undergraduate degree starting year one in September 2027. Selection uses academic merit and a short webform statement. Cannot be combined with another Exeter scholarship.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee status; conditional or unconditional offer for an eligible degree entering year one; equivalent of A level AAB achieved or achievable; not progressing from the International Study Centre International Foundation; self-funded. BMBS Medicine, BSc Medical Imaging (Diagnostic Radiography), two named law programmes and degree apprenticeships are excluded.
scholarships.deadline_note: Round 1 closes 2027-03-04 at 23:59 GMT; outcomes by 2027-04-06. The page does not describe later rounds.
scholarships.notes: Full terms and conditions are in a PDF not read. The award page does not list eligible countries beyond fee status.

scholarships.name: Exeter Excellence Scholarship 2027/28 (Postgraduate Taught, Round 1)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 15,000 off first-year international tuition fees, one year only
scholarships.summary: 150 awards for self-funded international students holding an offer for an eligible UK campus-based taught master's starting September 2027. Selection uses academic merit and a short webform statement. Cannot be combined with another Exeter scholarship.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee status; offer for an eligible master's; equivalent of a UK 2:1 achieved or achievable; self-funded. Excluded: One Planet MBA, MRes Economics, MRes Finance, MSc Island Biodiversity and Conservation, certain clinical psychology and law practice programmes, PGCerts, PGDips, degree apprenticeships and online programmes.
scholarships.deadline_note: Round 1 closes 2027-01-28; the page prints the time as 'II:59 GMT', so confirm the closing time. Outcomes by 2027-02-25.
scholarships.notes: Full terms and conditions are in a PDF not read. The award page does not list eligible countries. A 2026/27 round for January 2027 entry is open until 2026-11-26 but is not recorded here.

scholarships.name: University of Exeter Postgraduate Taught Scholarship 2027/28 for Pakistan
scholarships.value_text: GBP 10,000 tuition fee discount applied to the first year only
scholarships.summary: Automatic first-year tuition discount for self-funded Pakistani citizens or passport holders with international fee status who hold an offer for an eligible UK campus-based taught master's starting September 2027. Cannot be combined with another Exeter scholarship.
scholarships.criteria_text: Citizen or passport holder of Pakistan with international fee status; offer for an eligible taught master's in 2027/28; offer conditions met and tuition deposit paid; enrols in 2027/28; self-funded. Excluded: One Planet MBA, MRes Economics, MRes Finance, MSc Island Biodiversity and Conservation, certain clinical psychology and law practice programmes, MiPDAL, PGCerts, PGDips, degree apprenticeships and online programmes.
scholarships.notes: Cannot be held together with the Exeter Excellence Scholarship (GBP 15,000), so an applicant would hold one or the other. Page also mentions a separate January 2027 award for Pakistan (id=5678) whose value is not stated; not recorded. Full terms are in a country PDF not read.

scholarships.name: University of Exeter Alumni Scholarship 2027/28
scholarships.value_text: 20% reduction in first-year tuition fees, one year only
scholarships.summary: Automatic tuition discount for home and international Exeter alumni, including those who completed a study abroad period, a credit-bearing summer school or an online micro credential, who start most standalone taught master's or research degrees in 2027/28.
scholarships.criteria_text: Exeter undergraduate or postgraduate graduate, or completer of an inbound study abroad semester or year, a credit-bearing International Summer School or an online micro credential; meets programme entry requirements; enrols between 2027-09-01 and 2028-08-31. Excluded: MA Education (Online), Graduate Law LLB, University of Law programmes and MiPDAL.
scholarships.deadline_note: No separate application; previous Exeter study is declared in the application portal.
scholarships.notes: Moving within the same programme, such as PGCert to PGDip or MPhil to PhD, does not qualify. A separate Alumni Family and Friends Discount (20% off first-year fees for referred people) has no 2027/28 details yet and is not recorded.
